source: The Small / Normal / Large recognizer tiers, read by tools/analyse_selftest.py and the Rubi app's tier choice: change them here only. Weights: the owner's int8 ceilings of 2026-10-14 (Small < 1 MB, Normal <= 1.6 MB, Large <= 2.5 MB), set from v0.8.0-test.1's console timings and kept (2026-10-15) until a test build's console logs confirm larger ones. Box time: the owner's limits of 2026-10-14 for a typical full textbox (box), estimated; where a time limit is tighter than a weights ceiling, the time limit wins. Arena ceilings: bee-san/vita-vn-ocr docs/model-tiers.md, section 1.3. Reserve: fixed 1 MiB for every model size (owner, 2026-10-23; an estimate pending console validation), replacing the untuned 4/8/16 MiB margins after あおかな reported only 3 MiB free. Default: Normal (owner, 2026-10-15).
tier_keys: The tier picker's keys (API 21; the analyser ignores them). model: the tier's pinned recognizer in ux0:data/VitaJPOverlay/ocr (include/vjo_vocr_sizes.h VJO_VOCR_TIERn_NAME); a later generation's three blobs replace these through the pins. tagline: the Rubi app's line for it. est_box_ms: est_box_basis, at 333 MHz (what the Rubi app shows); est_box_ms_444: the same estimate at 444 MHz, the clock a job raises by default (ocr_boost_clock). job_bytes: the game's USER memory a first job of the model holds at the full screen, page-rounded weights + workspace + capture block (game_ocr/main.c's memory check), without the character LM, the confidence cascade's model or the PSP refinement, which a job leaves out first when memory is short, and without the helper threads of ocr_threads (API 22), which a job takes only when they also fit beside the same reserve (an estimate from the source, host/tests/test_vocr.c). need_bytes: job_bytes + reserve_bytes, the free game memory the tier needs to run; with less, a job runs the next smaller tier. The C tables (include/vjo_vocr_sizes.h, include/vjo_ledger_budget.h, core/config.c, core/vocr_models.c) hold the same values: tools/tests/test_model_tiers.py checks that they agree.
est_box_basis: Estimated ms to read a typical full textbox (3 lines of about 640 px, 240 CTC frames, greedy decoding, plus 0.1 s for the line finder) with the tier's model on one core of the console: bee-san/vita-vn-ocr eval/vocr5_protocol.json "estimates" (vita/a9_layers.py on the exact shapes, with vita-vn-ocr #85's runtime, the pin since API 22, and no credit for its weight prefetch, at 333 MHz, the clock without ocr_boost_clock; every phase's high bound calibrated so that VOCR3-H15 costs its measured 4,941.7 us per CTC frame on v0.8.0-test.1's console logs, 333 MHz assumed). At 444 MHz (ocr_boost_clock, the default) the same estimates are 0.50, 0.72 and 1.63 s (est_box_ms_444), and with credit for the prefetch 0.57, 0.81 and 1.47 s at 333 MHz; with ocr_threads' parallel lines a box takes less again. The beam + LM decoder adds well under 1 ms a line, its LM's first load and the confidence cascade more. No console has run a VOCR5 model yet: these are estimates until a test build's logs recalibrate them.
